conventions: Placeholders: [SHOT] [MOVE] [SUBJECT] [ACTION] [ENV] [LIGHT] [STYLE] [AUDIO]. Keep [STYLE] identical across a project. One primary motion per prompt.

templates.title: Establishing drone shot
templates.anatomy: starts wide → reveals geography
templates.prompt: Aerial pull-back over [ENV], dawn mist lifting, [LIGHT: golden hour backlight]. Slow, majestic. [STYLE]. [AUDIO: wind, distant birds.]

templates.title: Dialogue two-shot (shot-reverse-shot pair)
templates.anatomy: coverage, not chaos
templates.prompt:
Medium two-shot of [SUBJECT A] and [SUBJECT B] at [ENV], [LIGHT]. Static locked-off. [SUBJECT A] says, "[LINE]." [STYLE].
Close-up of [SUBJECT B] reacting, shallow depth of field, [LIGHT]. Static. [SUBJECT B] replies, "[LINE]." [STYLE].

templates.title: Emotional close-up
templates.anatomy: ration close-ups (micro-acting is the weakest link)
templates.prompt: Extreme close-up of [SUBJECT], eyes glistening, [LIGHT: soft window light, cool shadows]. Slow push-in. Micro-expression: restrained grief. [STYLE]. [AUDIO: room tone, faint breath.]

templates.title: Product macro orbit
templates.anatomy: one move (orbit) + one focus event
templates.prompt: Macro shot of [PRODUCT], [LIGHT: warm rim light, dark studio]. Slow 180-degree orbit, focus pull from reflections to label. [STYLE].

templates.title: Action tracking shot
templates.anatomy: camera pace matches subject pace
templates.prompt: Tracking shot alongside [SUBJECT] [ACTION: sprinting through rain-slick alley], [LIGHT: neon reflections, volumetric haze]. Handheld energy, motion blur. [STYLE].

templates.title: Horror creep
templates.anatomy: slow, hesitant verbs; danger hinted, not shown
templates.prompt: The hallway stretches, lit by a flickering bulb. The camera tilts cautiously, revealing a darkened doorway. [LIGHT: low-key, deep shadows]. [STYLE]. [AUDIO: faint whispers, floorboard creak.]

templates.title: Interview / talking head
templates.anatomy: static camera, clean front face, short lines
templates.prompt: Medium close-up of [SUBJECT], eye-level, [ENV: warm studio, soft bokeh]. Static tripod. [SUBJECT] says, "[LINE]." [STYLE].

templates.title: Dream sequence
templates.anatomy: orbit + atmosphere carry the effect
templates.prompt: Slow 360-degree orbit around [SUBJECT] in [ENV: surreal floating landscape], [LIGHT: bioluminescent glow, haze]. Weightless drift, soft focus. [STYLE]. [AUDIO: reversed piano, sub-bass swell.]

templates.title: Time-lapse city
templates.anatomy: static camera mandatory for timelapse
templates.prompt: Static wide shot of [CITY], day-to-night timelapse, traffic trails, windows igniting. [STYLE].

templates.title: Food commercial macro
templates.anatomy: texture + steam + dolly
templates.prompt: Macro close-up of [DISH], steam rising, [LIGHT: warm side light, shallow DOF]. Slow dolly-in. [STYLE]. [AUDIO: sizzle.]

templates.title: Fashion film
templates.anatomy: wardrobe locked in Identity Block
templates.prompt: Full shot of [MODEL] in [OUTFIT] walking toward camera on [RUNWAY/LOCATION], [LIGHT: golden hour rim]. Slow-motion, fabric in motion. [STYLE].

templates.title: Sci-fi corridor dolly
templates.anatomy: one corridor, one move, motivated practicals
templates.prompt: Slow dolly forward down [CORRIDOR], [LIGHT: cold fluorescent + red alert practicals], haze. [STYLE]. [AUDIO: starship hum, distant klaxon.]

templates.title: Underwater reveal
templates.anatomy: tilt reveals; light does the exposition. Models: Luma (fluid dynamics), Kling 3.0
templates.prompt: Camera tilts down from surface glare to reveal [SUBJECT] below, [LIGHT: caustic light rays, deep blue]. Slow descent. [STYLE].

templates.title: Car commercial
templates.anatomy: low angle = power; smooth move = luxury. Models: Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1
templates.prompt: Low-angle tracking shot of [CAR] on [ROAD] at blue hour, [LIGHT: headlight bloom, city glow]. Smooth gimbal. [STYLE].

templates.title: Match-cut transition pair
templates.anatomy: identical motion vector across the cut; lock endpoints
templates.prompt:
[SUBJECT] opens [DOOR A] in [ENV A], swings toward camera. Match-cut motion. [STYLE].
Same swing continues as [DOOR B] opens in [ENV B], revealing [REVEAL]. [STYLE].

templates.title: Anime action (sakuga)
templates.anatomy: cel/sakuga/impact frames, NO lens or DOF language. Models: PixVerse (Anime), Vidu Q1, Pika
templates.prompt: Cel-animated action cut: [CHARACTER] dashes forward, speed lines and impact frames, painted background holds still. Sakuga flourish on the strike. STYLE LOCK: bold colors, expressive features, dramatic lighting, hand-drawn anime.

templates.title: Ghibli-style landscape
templates.prompt: Hand-painted pastoral landscape, drifting clouds, grass swaying; a [CHARACTER] walks a winding path. Gentle, held frames, watercolor skies. STYLE LOCK: Studio Ghibli-inspired hand-drawn, soft light, painterly detail.

templates.title: Pixar-style 3D character beat
templates.prompt: Stylized 3D animation: [CHARACTER: big expressive eyes, soft rounded forms] reacts with surprise, squash-and-stretch. Warm key light, soft bounce. STYLE LOCK: modern 3D animated film, subsurface warmth, clean shapes.

templates.title: 2D cartoon dialogue
templates.prompt: Flat 2D cartoon: [CHARACTER A] and [CHARACTER B] talk at [LOCATION], simple shapes, bold outlines, limited animation, mouth shapes on dialogue beats. STYLE LOCK: western 2D cartoon, flat colors, thick outlines.

templates.title: Stop-motion claymation gag
templates.prompt: Stop-motion clay: [CHARACTER] slips on a banana peel, limbs flail in stepped poses, visible fingerprints in the clay, miniature set, warm practical lighting. STYLE LOCK: Aardman/Laika stop-motion, handcrafted, stepped motion.

templates.title: Oil-painting painterly motion
templates.prompt: Oil painting come alive: [SCENE] rendered in thick impasto brushstrokes, paint swirls as clouds move, canvas texture visible. STYLE LOCK: painterly, visible brushwork, impasto, no photorealism.

templates.title: Pixel-art game cinematic
templates.prompt: Pixel-art cinematic: [CHARACTER] traverses [ENV], parallax layers scroll, limited palette, chunky pixels, chiptune energy. STYLE LOCK: 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, retro palette.

templates.title: Felt-art cozy scene
templates.prompt: Felt-art stop-motion: [CHARACTER] made of stitched felt sips tea in a cozy room, fibers visible, gentle bobbing motion. STYLE LOCK: felt craft, soft fibers, handmade warmth.

templates.title: Dialogue drama close-up
templates.prompt: Close-up of [SUBJECT], natural skin texture with visible pores, [LIGHT: soft window light, cool practical fill]. Static locked-off. [SUBJECT] says quietly, "[LINE]." STYLE LOCK: cinematic realism, 35mm film grain, shallow DOF, muted grade.

templates.title: Documentary handheld
templates.prompt: Handheld follow of [SUBJECT] through [LOCATION], natural daylight, slight motion blur, muted grade, authentic feel. No music. STYLE LOCK: documentary realism, imperfect framing allowed.

templates.title: Car commercial (photoreal)
templates.prompt: Low-angle tracking of [CAR] at blue hour, anamorphic lens flare, wet asphalt reflections, [LIGHT: mixed streetlight temperatures]. STYLE LOCK: automotive commercial, ARRI Alexa, 35mm, teal-orange.

templates.title: Food macro (photoreal)
templates.prompt: Macro of [DISH], steam, glistening texture, [LIGHT: warm side light, dark background], 100mm macro shallow DOF. Slow dolly-in. STYLE LOCK: food commercial, high detail, warm grade.

templates.title: Horror corridor (photoreal)
templates.prompt: Slow dolly down [CORRIDOR], practical flickering fluorescents, deep shadows, dust in the air, 16mm grain. STYLE LOCK: horror realism, low-key chiaroscuro, motivated practicals.

templates.title: Sci-fi corridor dolly (photoreal)
templates.prompt: Slow dolly forward, [LIGHT: cold fluorescents + red alert practicals], volumetric haze, lens breathing. STYLE LOCK: sci-fi realism, anamorphic, cool grade, subtle grain.

templates.title: Fashion editorial (photoreal)
templates.prompt: Full shot of [MODEL], [OUTFIT], [LOCATION], golden hour rim light, fabric motion, shallow DOF, 85mm. STYLE LOCK: high-fashion editorial, film grain, warm grade.

templates.title: Nature drone (photoreal)
templates.prompt: Aerial pull-back over [LANDSCAPE], dawn mist, golden backlight, slow majestic drift. STYLE LOCK: nature documentary, natural color, subtle grain.

templates.title: Restraint pass, subtle acting
templates.anatomy: one tactic, one micro-action, the restraint pass tames AI over-acting
templates.prompt: Medium close-up of [SUBJECT], [LIGHT: soft natural key]. [SUBJECT] performs [MICRO-ACTION: small and restrained, a glance away, a held breath], tactic: [TACTIC: to deflect]. Eyes track the scene partner, blink naturally, never stare into the lens. [STYLE]. [AUDIO: room tone.]

templates.title: Dead-eyes fix, give the eyes a job
templates.anatomy: eyes need a job every 2 to 3 seconds or they die on screen
templates.prompt: Close-up of [SUBJECT] [ACTION: listening], [LIGHT]. Eyes move with purpose: glance to [FOCUS POINT], blink on the thought change, micro-reaction at [BEAT]. Never hold a glassy stare. [STYLE].

templates.title: Tactics-driven dialogue beat
templates.anatomy: tactic + line + one physical action = playable direction
templates.prompt: [SHOT] of [SUBJECT] at [ENV], [LIGHT]. [SUBJECT] says "[LINE]" with tactic [TACTIC: to accuse], physical action [ACTION: leaning in, controlled]. Subtext lives in the body, not the face, no mugging. [STYLE]. [AUDIO: dialogue + room tone.]

templates.title: Scene-locked ensemble
templates.anatomy: spatial locks stop the model merging or teleporting performers
templates.prompt: Wide shot of [ENV], [LIGHT]. [SUBJECT A] [ACTION A: tending the fire, stage left], [SUBJECT B] [ACTION B: watching, stage right], each performer holds one spatial zone and one action, no crossing. Static camera. [STYLE].

templates.title: Listening reaction, the other half of dialogue
templates.anatomy: listening shots sell dialogue; AI defaults to blank, direct the arc
templates.prompt: Close-up of [SUBJECT] listening, [LIGHT: soft key]. Micro-expression arc: neutral → [EMOTION: dawning concern] across the line. Small head tilt, breath catch, eyes drop then return. [STYLE]. [AUDIO: faint room tone, partner's muffled line.]

templates.title: TTS dialogue line with direction tags
templates.anatomy: bracketed tags and punctuation are the TTS director's camera moves
templates.prompt: [VOICE: voice-bible descriptor, age, texture, pace]. [SUBJECT] says: "[LINE]" [pause 0.5s] "[LINE 2, quieter]". Direction: [EMOTION] rising to [EMOTION]; do not rush the last word.

templates.title: Voice-designed narration (Voice Bible)
templates.anatomy: cast the voice like an actor; consistency comes from the bible, not the engine
templates.prompt: Narration, [VOICE BIBLE: 40s, gravel texture, slow deliberate pace, slight regional lilt, never rushed]. Script: "[NARRATION]". Record three passes, neutral, weary, warm, and pick in the edit.

templates.title: AI music cue brief
templates.anatomy: brief the arc and demand stems; never temp-track with a song you cannot clear
templates.prompt: Cue: [CUE NAME], [DURATION]s, enters at [TIMECODE]. Brief: [REFERENCE FEEL, describe it, never name a track you cannot clear], tempo [BPM], key [KEY], instrumentation [INSTRUMENTS], arc: [ARC: sparse → swell → cut on the door slam]. Deliver stems. Rights: licensed or AI-generated per project policy, see the rights chapter.

templates.title: Foley pass, three-layer sound design
templates.anatomy: three layers spotted to picture, production, foley, design
templates.prompt: Scene [SCENE]: layer 1, production sound [DIALOGUE / ROOM TONE]; layer 2, foley [FOOTSTEPS / CLOTH / PROPS performed to picture]; layer 3, designed [WHOOSHES / IMPACTS]. Spot every effect to the frame it lands on; nothing floats.

templates.title: Style-locked scene plate
templates.anatomy: the style bible repeated verbatim is what survives 90 minutes
templates.prompt: STYLE LOCK: [STYLE BIBLE, one line, verbatim in every scene]. Scene [N]: [SHOT] of [SUBJECT] [ACTION] at [ENV], [LIGHT]. [CAMERA MOVE]. [STYLE BIBLE repeated verbatim].

templates.title: Character re-entry (consistency)
templates.anatomy: re-entry prompts restate identity; never trust the model to remember
templates.prompt: [SHOT] of [SUBJECT: identity label + three locked visual traits], re-entering at [ENV], [LIGHT]. Match the approved reference frame [REFERENCE]: same wardrobe, same hair, same build, no redesigns between scenes. [STYLE].

templates.title: Native-audio dialogue scene
templates.anatomy: native-audio models keep voice and face in one generation, no dub drift
templates.prompt: [SHOT] of [SUBJECT A] and [SUBJECT B] at [ENV], [LIGHT]. [SUBJECT A] says "[LINE]", generate WITH native dialogue audio, lip-sync locked. Performance tactic: [TACTIC]. [STYLE]. [AUDIO: dialogue + room tone, no music.]

templates.title: Sequence bridge (match-cut)
templates.anatomy: design the seam, AI features die in the transitions
templates.prompt: End of scene [N]: [SHOT A: final-frame description]. Start of scene [N+1]: [SHOT B: opening-frame description], match on [MATCH: shape / color / motion]. Bridge the cut with [TRANSITION: whip-pan / match-cut / sound bridge]. [STYLE].

templates.title: Face-morph rescue
templates.anatomy: shorter + locked frame + static camera starves the morph
templates.prompt: RESCUE for a morphing face: shorten to [DURATION: 3s], lock the start frame [REFERENCE], static camera, [SUBJECT] holds [SIMPLE ACTION]. Exclude: morphing faces, shifting features, extra limbs. If it still morphs, regenerate from the locked frame, do not extend.

templates.title: Identity-drift repair
templates.anatomy: the approved frame IS the identity; everything regenerates from it
templates.prompt: RESCUE for identity drift: rebuild from the approved-frame library, start frame [REFERENCE], [SUBJECT: three locked traits restated]. One action, uncrowded frame. Compare output to the reference before accepting; reject on any trait change.

templates.title: Plasticky wide-shot fix
templates.anatomy: AI faces need pixels, shoot closer or composite
templates.prompt: RESCUE for plasticky faces in wides: punch in, regenerate as [SHOT: medium close-up] of [SUBJECT], [LIGHT], natural skin texture, pores, catchlights. If the wide is otherwise good, composite the close face over it in post.
